none.instruction: No hands. Put both hands down, out of the picture.
none.subject: subject2

R_near_open.instruction: Right hand only. Palm to the camera, fingers open, close to the camera.
R_near_open.subject: subject2

R_far_open.instruction: Right hand only. Palm to the camera, fingers open, far from the camera. Lean back.
R_far_open.subject: subject2

R_point.instruction: Right hand only. Index finger pointing up, other fingers closed.
R_point.subject: subject2

L_near_open.instruction: Left hand only. Palm to the camera, fingers open, close to the camera.
L_near_open.subject: subject2

L_far_open.instruction: Left hand only. Palm to the camera, fingers open, far from the camera. Lean back.
L_far_open.subject: subject2

L_point.instruction: Left hand only. Index finger pointing up, other fingers closed.
L_point.subject: subject2

both_apart.instruction: Both hands. Palms to the camera, clearly apart from each other.
both_apart.subject: subject2

both_crossing.instruction: Both hands. Cross your forearms in an X, both hands visible.
both_crossing.subject: subject2

R_fast_wave.instruction: Right hand only. Wave fast from side to side.
R_fast_wave.subject: subject2

R_enter_leave.instruction: Right hand only. Raise it into view, lower it out of view, about once a second.
R_enter_leave.subject: subject2
